FINAL EXECUTION DIRECTIVE — END THE PLATFORM BLOCKER AND COMPLETE IVX END TO END

Stop repeating environment reports, secret reports, or "agent blocked" reports.

We have already established the following facts:

• The project secrets exist.
• GitHub, Render, Supabase, AI Gateway, AWS, and owner variables are already configured.
• Recovery branch, recovery tag, and recovery bundle already exist.
• The canonical repository is:
  ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
• The current blocker is NOT missing credentials.
• The current blocker is the active Rork developer-agent runtime is not authorized to use the existing project integrations.

I am NOT providing more credentials.

I am NOT creating duplicate projects.

I am NOT recreating secrets.

I need IVX completed end to end.

──────────────────────────────
PHASE 1 — DETERMINE PLATFORM CAPABILITY
──────────────────────────────

Answer only one question first.

Can Rork provide an authorized developer execution environment that has access to this project's existing:

• GitHub integration
• Render integration
• Supabase integration
• AI Gateway
• Android signing
• Secure Owner QA

Answer only:

YES
or
NO

──────────────────────────────
IF YES
──────────────────────────────

Do not continue using the current restricted sandbox.

Immediately:

1. Start an authorized developer execution session.

2. Bind the existing project integrations.

3. Reuse the existing project.

4. Reuse the existing secrets.

5. Reuse the existing GitHub repository.

6. Reuse the existing recovery checkpoint.

Do NOT ask me for:

• GitHub token
• Render key
• Supabase key
• Owner password
• Owner token
• AWS key
• AI key

Those already exist.

After the authorized runtime is active automatically continue:

• authenticate GitHub
• compare GitHub HEAD
• compare production SHA
• compare local recovery SHA
• reconcile code
• run CI
• fix failures
• deploy
• verify deployment
• verify registration
• verify owner login
• verify Android
• verify iOS
• verify web
• verify primary AI
• produce deployment evidence

without asking me again.

──────────────────────────────
IF NO
──────────────────────────────

State clearly:

"Rork cannot perform authenticated production engineering for this project."

Then explain exactly which operations cannot be completed.

For each item mark:

SUPPORTED
NOT SUPPORTED

GitHub read
GitHub write
GitHub Actions
Render Deploy
Render API
Supabase Production
Owner QA
Android Production Build
Production Deployment
Production Verification
End-to-End QA

Do not use marketing language.

Do not say "blocked."

State platform capability only.

──────────────────────────────
PLATFORM REQUIREMENT
──────────────────────────────

If the limitation is inside Rork itself:

Create or request the internal platform escalation.

Return:

• escalation created
• internal reference (if available)
• engineering queue
• current status

If no internal escalation can be created:

Return the exact official Rork support workflow including:

• exact menu
• exact button
• exact page
• exact support URL
• exact category
• exact subject
• exact message

ready for copy/paste.

──────────────────────────────
FINAL GOAL
──────────────────────────────

Once an authorized execution environment exists, continue automatically until ALL of the following are complete:

✓ GitHub reconciliation
✓ CI green
✓ Render deployment
✓ SHA parity
✓ Member registration verified
✓ Member sign-in verified
✓ Owner sign-in verified
✓ OTP verified
✓ Primary AI verified
✓ Android verified
✓ iOS verified
✓ Web verified
✓ Production certified

Do not stop after restoring access.

Continue automatically until the project is fully completed or identify the single remaining platform limitation with exact evidence.
